english: 38-39. Except in the case of fruits and flowers and Pānaka (special consecrated drink) a wise devotee should not offer anything on the hand. If oil, salt and pickles are offered on the hand or in an iron vessel, only Rākṣasas will partake of them. After offering the cooked food in the vessels (plates) of the Brāhmaṇa, the devotee should perform the rite of Saṃkalpa silently.
